defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its approach is based on shortest paths and combinations of delegated-language connections, which does not correctly optimize shared intermediate Steiner vertices and can double-count or miss shared module costs.
It applies ordinary Kruskal MST logic over the whole graph, forcing a spanning tree for all languages instead of finding a minimum Steiner tree spanning only the delegated languages.
